parsed.note_claim: Speed tape is widely used for quick, temporary repairs on aircraft exteriors until permanent repairs can be made.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Speed tape is an aluminium pressure-sensitive tape used to perform minor repairs on aircraft and racing cars. It is used as a temporary repair material until a more permanent repair can be carried out.
parsed.reason: The Wikipedia page directly confirms that speed tape is used for temporary minor repairs on aircraft until permanent repairs are made.
